notes.title: Steam Sale and Speedrun Contest!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

Here's a quick reminder for our super-sale that ends on November 19th; until then, grab TNI for half price!

Also, you have the opportunity to show us your talent and speed ; take part to  [url=https://youtu.be/mowkWnmk9Kg]the speedrun contest[/url]

* WHEN? The competition runs from November 13 to December 13, 2016.

* WHAT'S THE PRIZE? A terrific 11x17 inch key art featuring your caricature, signed by the development team. 

* WHICH LEVELS? To enter the contest, players need to speedrun through Act 3 – Level 12.

* HOW? Just tag Talent Not Included or @TNIgame into the description of your video, if uploaded on YouTube, OR send the video capture to supporttni@frimastudio.com, with “TNI Speedrun Contest” in the subject field.

By the way, our awesome dev Raph is still the best at this! And we're still waiting for another brave knight to pit his wits against him... 

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25929834/2393dd7f784e2863906365ef254e508526d45d44.jpg[/img]

notes.title: INSULT FIGHT
notes.notes:
You’re probably familiar with the concept of body language and verbal expression.

For TNI’s heroes, body language is often associated with the handling of weapons, or the art of dodging or jumping, while verbal language is used to...well...

Actually, verbal expression is also used as a weapon.

Since the dawn of time, having some skill with words has ever been an asset, and getting involved in verbal sparring could prove fatal. At least for your self-esteem.

The art of repartee is a talent that Bonnie, Cécile and Gundelf seem to master. In the words of the author of The Three Musketeers, ": Yes, I insulted him. But I wanted to fight him, and when one wants to fight with someone, one has to insult them”.

But careful, not any sort of insult. The barb must be strong but hidden, and the creativity and guile must show through the syntax.

This is why each confrontation is interspersed with formal and refined exchanges between the heroes and their opponents.

By the way, did you catch all the references hidden in there?

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25929834/cc8636870693c3b3ecce1e76ae27bbde32a4aae0.png[/img]

notes.title: Why Shakespeare?
notes.notes:
Kevin, Derp and Zordock: with such names, needless to say, you get categorized.

Of course, this is useful when you like bloody fightings, and when swaggering around is part of your daily pride. But imagine for a moment that you want to make a career change. Who would hire Derp to be a magistrate or even Zordock a social mediator?

And yet... The big muscles can sometimes hide big hearts.

Let me take you back in time, to a warm summer’s day. While holding the skull of his freshly slaughtered enemy, Kevin realized that he did not know whether to be or not to be so evil. He postulated this question aloud to his cohorts. 
 
Zordock, bad-tempered and impulsive, replied that it was much ado about nothing... 

But Derp came to calm the situation by reminding them that the important thing is to believe in yourself, because it is what is in our hearts that must lead our actions: besides, what's in a name? That which we call a rose by any other name would smell as sweet.

A scholar, dying not far from there, let out a groan upon hearing these familiar maxims, but all he managed to whisper before breathing his last breath, was "please shake that spear..." The three monsters understood none of these final words. All they detained was a strange name, Shakespeare; and in the course of their research, they found themselves passionately loving the author, whose moral opened unexpected possibilities.

Thus was born the love of three bloodthirsty monsters to the illustrious English scholar, and how their repulsive shell cracked open to reveal an ounce of sensitiveness.


[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25929834/06d52748193f0da144d1ad195ada387894c1650e.png[/img]

notes.title: TNI Patch note
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

We really appreciate that you take a moment to tell us what you like or not; the issue with the controllers came quite often, so we decided to modify them. Here are the main points we're working on:

[list]
[*][b]Remapping the controls[/b]
- The controls can now be remapped using all keyboard keys (except Esc) and mouse buttons!
- Note : Controller buttons cannot be remapped; only keyboard/mouse buttons.

[*][b]Mouse support in menus[/b]
- Player scan now use the mouse to navigate the menus! As mentioned above, gameplay actions can now be assigned to the mouse.

[*][b]Input selection screen[/b]
- The menu structure will undergo some minor changes. This screen appears once a game mode has been selected (‘Single-Player’ or ‘Multiplayer’). There, each player can select an input device (controller/keyboard). For instance, if I have two controllers and one keyboard, I can assign a controller to Player 1 and the keyboard to Player 2 by pressing the appropriate button (e.g. ‘Press A to join’).
- Note : We are considering removing the ‘Single-Player’ and ‘Multiplayer’ buttons from the main menu and replacing them with a ‘Play’ button, as the input selection screen renders them obsolete.

I'll keep you updated when they'e all effective!

Have a great week

notes.title: That Bird in TNI
notes.notes:
If you've already played TNI, you probably met at least one chicken.

And if you met that chicken, you're probably wondering where it comes from.

So the next question is: have you played Zelda: Ocarina of Time, before?

If you have, you probably know there are some wicked chickens that become warrior-chickens when attacked. Well, not REALLY warriors, but they know how to fight back if you bother them.

A game designer on TNI got traumatized by these non standard chickens, and wanted to get his revenge. One of the solutions was to put them in TNI as ennemies, so the players could fight them AND DESTROY THEM ALL.

That's how these birds ended in TNI.

But we're not monsters; we gave them shiny armors and dignity, so they fight with honor.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25929834/14117640e0536fccef7c181b0d0ddaecf2756988.png[/img]

notes.title: Talent Not Included will be available on Tuesday, August 30th!
notes.notes:
Talent Not Included is an action/combat platformer in which you will be playing three mediocre actors chosen by Zot, a demonic critic, in hopes of making a nice profit out of your marvelous performance. Mechanical soldiers, animals, hard-headed monsters, and rotating cylinders will challenge you in one of the most demanding plays to ever hit the stage!

Are you ready to take center stage? Talent Not Included will be available for download for PC and Mac on Tuesday, August 30th!

For more information follow us on Twitter @TNIgame (https://twitter.com/TNIgame)
